translations.buildersPrivacy.scope.content: This policy describes the personal data processed for the Idem Builders programme: your application, its review, the benefits granted and the public showcase. It supplements the IDEM Privacy Policy, which continues to apply to the rest of your use of IDEM.
translations.buildersPrivacy.controller.content: The data controller is IDEM, Douala, Cameroon. For any question about your data: legal@idem.africa.
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.identity: your IDEM account identifier, email address and display name;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.project: the project you submit: its name, description, country and public address;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.pitch: the text in which you explain how the project puts Africa forward;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.signals: a snapshot, taken on the day you apply, of what the project does with IDEM — only yes or no for each item (online with iDeploy, marketing in IDEM, domain, brand, business plan…), never the content of your documents;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.consent: the proof that you accepted the terms: version, date and time, IP address and browser identifier;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.decision: the decision: status, date, team member who decided and, in case of refusal, the reason;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.benefits: the benefits granted, recorded in your wallet history;
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.emails: the sending record of the emails about your application (address, date, delivery status).
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.not.title: What we do not collect
translations.buildersPrivacy.data.not.content: The programme asks for no identity document, no bank or Mobile Money details and no information about your customers.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.content: Each use has its own purpose and legal basis:
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.review: Reviewing your application and answering it — basis: your request and these terms.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.benefits: Granting and applying the benefits (bonus, top-up credit, hosting discount) — basis: performance of the programme terms.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.showcase: Publishing the project on the showcase — basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.emails: Writing to you about your application and the programme — basis: performance of the programme terms.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.proof: Keeping the proof of your acceptance and preventing fraud (multiple accounts, fictitious projects) — basis: the legitimate interest of IDEM.
translations.buildersPrivacy.purposes.stats: Measuring the programme with aggregated statistics, which identify no one — basis: the legitimate interest of IDEM.
translations.buildersPrivacy.public.content: If your project is admitted, the showcase shows only its name, its short description, its country, its public address and the date of admission. Your email address, your name, your application text, the reason for a decision and the usage snapshot are never published. You can ask at any time to hide the project from the showcase.
translations.buildersPrivacy.recipients.team: The IDEM team members in charge of the programme, through the administration panel; their access requires authentication and their actions are logged.
translations.buildersPrivacy.recipients.providers: The technical providers IDEM relies on to host the platform and send emails, bound by confidentiality and acting only on IDEM instructions.
translations.buildersPrivacy.recipients.authorities: Public authorities, only when the law requires it.
translations.buildersPrivacy.recipients.nosale.title: No sale, no advertising
translations.buildersPrivacy.recipients.nosale.conten: Your data is never sold, rented or shared for advertising purposes.
translations.buildersPrivacy.hosting.content: Programme data is stored in the IDEM platform database, on the servers IDEM uses for the whole platform. When a provider processes data outside your country, IDEM requires contractual guarantees of a level of protection equivalent to this policy.
translations.buildersPrivacy.retention.refused: Application not admitted: 12 months after the decision, then deleted.
translations.buildersPrivacy.retention.member: Admitted application: for the whole membership, then 3 years after you leave the programme.
translations.buildersPrivacy.retention.proof: Proof of acceptance of the terms: 5 years after the end of your participation, to answer a possible dispute.
translations.buildersPrivacy.retention.ledger: Wallet entries for the credits granted: for the period required by accounting rules (10 years under OHADA accounting law).
translations.buildersPrivacy.security.content: Data travels encrypted (HTTPS). Access to the administration panel is restricted to authenticated team members, and each decision records who made it. The programme collects only what the review needs.
translations.buildersPrivacy.automated.content: Before you apply, IDEM automatically checks whether the project is run with IDEM. This check only opens or closes the application form; it never decides on admission. Every decision is taken by a person.
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.content: Under the applicable law, including Cameroon law no. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on the protection of personal data, you have the right to:
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.access: access your data and obtain a copy of it;
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.erase: have it deleted, within the limits of the retention periods in section 8;
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.object: object to a processing based on legitimate interest, or ask for it to be limited;
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.withdraw: withdraw your consent to the showcase, or leave the programme, at any time;
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.portability: receive the data you provided in a common, readable format.
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.how.title: How to exercise them
translations.buildersPrivacy.rights.how.content: Write to legal@idem.africa from the address of your IDEM account. IDEM answers within 30 days and may ask you to prove your identity. If you are not satisfied with the answer, you can lodge a complaint with the personal data protection authority of your country.
translations.buildersPrivacy.minors.content: The programme is open to adults only. IDEM deletes any application found to come from a minor.
translations.buildersPrivacy.changes.content: IDEM may update this policy. Substantial changes are announced by email and in the console before they apply. The version you accepted is recorded with your application.
translations.buildersPrivacy.contact.content: Personal data: legal@idem.africa. Programme: contact@idem.africa. IDEM, Douala, Cameroon.
